purpose: Freeze the minimal D-vintage per-security information required for later V2.8.3 confirmation so no D feature or market state is recomputed from a later T-vintage.
input_gates: signal_date has ELIGIBLE_FEATURE_SOURCE under V2.8.3 exact-vintage materialization gate
exact stock and benchmark bytes match the admitted source pin
an effective official prospective universe authority exists for D

factor_definitions.rv10_over_rv60: population std(ddof=0) of latest 10 daily log source-close returns through D divided by population std(ddof=0) of latest 60 daily log source-close returns through D
factor_definitions.tr10_over_tr60: mean latest 10 valid tr_pct through D divided by mean latest 60 valid tr_pct through D
factor_definitions.market_state: CALM iff CSI300 rv10/rv60 <= 1; otherwise STRESSED; UNKNOWN if 60-return warmup unavailable

population_rule.authority: official prospective Certified Mother Pool snapshot effective for D
population_rule.vendor_symbol_mapping: security_code -> exact one canonical_security_id in the effective official universe authority
population_rule.ambiguous_or_missing_mapping: exclude row and activate data-quality blocker if ambiguity affects source integrity
population_rule.newly listed_security: included only when present in the official prospective universe authority and sufficient 60-bar factor history exists

future_outcome_join.D_economic_price_for_return: must NOT use source_close_d frozen here; D and T economic endpoints are later read together from the same T-vintage under the V2.6 endpoint rule
future_outcome_join.source_close_d_role: diagnostic only for reproducibility of D-vintage feature construction
